domains.name: Design Secure Architectures
key_traps: SCPs do not grant permissions; they only define maximum permission boundaries across accounts
WAF operates at Layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS) while Network Firewall and Security Groups/NACLs operate at Layers 3/4
GuardDuty analyzes CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and DNS logs without deploying agents

domains.name: Design Resilient Architectures
key_traps: Global Accelerator provides two static Anycast IPs and routes over the AWS global network, whereas CloudFront caches content at edge locations
Route 53 Multi-Value Answer returns up to 8 healthy records (not a substitute for an ELB)

domains.name: Design High-Performing Architectures
key_traps: Global Accelerator improves performance for non-HTTP (TCP/UDP) and dynamic HTTP workloads requiring static IPs
DNS TTL caching behavior vs immediate failover via Global Accelerator health checks

domains.name: Design Cost-Optimized Architectures
key_traps: VPC Gateway Endpoints exist only for S3 and DynamoDB and are free; Interface Endpoints use PrivateLink and incur hourly + data charges
